reader_summary.headline: Rob Vinall celebrates RV Capital's 20th anniversary by reviewing six life periods that shaped his investing.
reader_summary.overview: The episode marks the fund's 20th anniversary on August 17, 2026. Rob looks back at six life periods that influenced his character and investment style. He also shares updates from his letters to co-investors regarding portfolio progress and specific lessons learned from past deals.

key_points.text: Rob reflects on six distinct periods of his life that shaped him as both a person and an investor.
key_points.evidence_quote: Rob looks back on six periods of his life that shaped him as a person and an investor.

key_points.text: The host explains why current pessimism about AI created a chance to buy a compounder at a good price.
key_points.evidence_quote: Rob outlines why the current pessimism around AI created the opportunity to buy a compounder at an attractive price.

key_points.text: The discussion covers the debate between buying undervalued companies versus those with strong narratives even if prices are high.
